t: 7856 April 12 1937 Inspection of Japanese Naval Landing Party

pages.en:
Copy from Daily Report of Officer in Charge of Dixwell Road Police Station.

Monday, April 12th, 1937.
7856
12 4 37

INSPECTION OF
JAPANESE NAVAL
LANDING PARTY.
Between 11a.m. and 11-20a.m. 12-4-37 mechanised units of
the Japanese Naval Landing Party were reviewed on Klangwan
Road by Admiral Mineo Ohsumi, Supreme War Councillor. Previous
to the actual review, three rehearsals were staged commencing
at 10 a.m.
At 11-30a.m. the Admiral proceeded to Hongkew Park where
he inspected other detachments of the Landing Party who after-
wards marched past in review order. At the conclusion of the
review, at 12-15p.m. the Admiral returned to the destroyer
"Myoko." Precautionary measures were adopted and traffic
arrangements made by officers of this station under Inspector
in charge. D.O."C" attended. There were no untoward incidents

Jormalton
................Inspector.
Officer in charge.

D.C. (Spl. Branch).

1937年4月12日，星期一。
7856
12 4 37

检阅
日本海军
陆战队。
1937年4月12日上午11时至11时20分之间，最高军事参议官大角岑生（Mineo Ohsumi）海军上将在江湾路检阅了日本海军陆战队的机械化部队。在正式检阅之前，于上午10时开始进行了三次预演。
上午11时30分，海军上将前往虹口公园，检阅陆战队其他分队，随后这些分队按检阅队形列队行进通过。检阅于下午12时15分结束，海军上将返回驱逐舰“妙高”号（Myoko）。在本站主管督察的指挥下，本站警员采取了预防措施并安排了交通管制。C区值班警官出席。未发生任何意外事件。

Copy from Daily Report of Officer in Charge of Dixwell Road Police Station.

Saturday, April 10th, 1937.

7856
12 4 37

CHAPEL FIRE
ENGINES USING
MUNICIPAL
ROADS.
C.P.C. 67 reports having observed two engines Nos 47 and
48 belonging to the Third Division Chapel Fire Brigade
proceeding North along North Szechuen Road near Paoshing Road
at 3 p.m. 9-4-37, carrillion bells ringing.

MOVEMENTS OF
ADMIRAL
OHSUMI.
Admiral Mineo Osumi, Japanese Supreme War Counsellor
arrived at the Japanese Naval Headquarters at 9 a.m. 9-4-37.
At 9.15 a.m. he proceeded to Hongkew Park where he inspected
officers and men of the Naval Landing Party thereafter
proceeding to the Officers Club No. 305 Darroch Road. At 1.00
p.m. he visited the war zone of 1932 by way of Kiangwan Road
returning again at 1.20p.m. thence proceeding to the Landing
Party detachment at No. 635 North Szechuen Road. Leaving here
at 1.35p.m. he visited various places in the Settlement return-
ing to the Officers Club at 5.5p.m. where he stayed the night.
Precautionary measures were adopted and traffic arrange-
ments were made by officers of this station under Inspector
i/c. There were no untoward incidents.

Immelson Inspector.
Officer-in-Charge.

D.C. (Spl. Branch).

S.I.

中央公园巡捕房（C.P.C.）67号报告称，观察到第三分区教堂消防队的两辆消防车（编号47和48）于1937年4月9日下午3时，鸣响钟琴，沿北四川路靠近宝兴路处向北行驶。

大角
海军上将
动向。
日本最高军事参议官大角岑生（Mineo Osumi）海军上将于1937年4月9日上午9时抵达日本海军司令部。上午9时15分，他前往虹口公园，检阅海军陆战队官兵，随后前往达罗克路305号军官俱乐部。下午1时，他经由江湾路视察1932年战区，于下午1时20分返回，随即前往北四川路635号的陆战队分队驻地。下午1时35分离开该处后，他巡视了租界内的多处地点，并于下午5时5分返回军官俱乐部过夜。在本站主管督察的指挥下，本站警员采取了预防措施并安排了交通管制。未发生任何意外事件。

REPORT
Date April 9, 1937.
Subject Further Amended Schedule of the Movements of Admiral Mineo Ohsumi.
Made by D. S. Kamashita Forwarded by J Boyne D S I.

At 2.30 p.m. April 9, a telephone message was received
by D.S. Kamashita from Inspector Hirai, Dixwell Road Station,
to the effect that Admiral Mineo Ohsumi will leave the Japanese
Naval Officers' Club, No. 305 Darroch Road, for the cruiser
"Myoko" at 7 a.m. April 10 via North Szechuen, Range, Woosung,
Boone, Broadway and Yangtszepoo Roads to the Ewo Jetty. It
is also stated that the admiral will land at the Ewo Jetty
at 1 p.m., the same day, and will inspect former war zone
proceeding along Yangtszepoo, Broadway, Boone, Woosung, Range
and North Honan Roads and thence into Chinese controlled
territory. Further movements of the admiral will be
carried out in accordance to the schedule circulated on
April 8.

D. Kamashita
D. S.

CONFIDENTIAL
Amended Schedule of the Movements of Admiral Mieno
Ohsumi.
The following amendments have been made in the programme
of Admiral Ohsumi's movements during his stay in Shanghai
from April 8 to April 11.-
April 9
8.50 a.m. The admiral will land at the Ewo Jetty, Wayside,
and proceed to the Japanese Naval Landing Party
Headquarters via Broadway, Boone, Woosung, Range
and North Szechuen Roads.
9.15 a.m. Leave the Naval Landing Party Headquarters
and proceed to Hongkew Park via Kiangwan Road
entering by the West gate. Here an inspection
of the officers and men of the Landing Party
will take place.
9.45 a.m. Leaving the Park, the admiral will return to
the Naval Landing Party Headquarters via the West
gate and Kiangwan Road.
1 p.m. Leave the Naval Officers' Club, No. 305 Darroch
Road and proceed to inspect the former war zone
by way of Kiangwan Road and thence into Chinese
controlled territory at the railway crossing
opposite the West gate of Hongkew Park.
（印：COUNCIL OF COMMUNITY OF SHANGHAI * CHANGHAI * 9 APR. 19..）
Re-enter the Settlement at the same point and
traverse the following roads to the Naval Landing
Party detachment, No. 635 North Szechuen Road.-
Kiangwan, North Szechuen, Scott, Uyang(歐陽)
(Chapei), Sutah(四達)(Chapei), Scott, North Sze-
chuen Roads.
1.30 p.m. Leaving the detachment the admiral will proceed
to the Naval Club for Petty Officers and Sailors,
No. 400 Miller Road, via North Szechuen, Range,
Chapoo, Haining and Miller Roads. S.I.

大角海军上将在4月8日至4月11日逗留上海期间的行程计划已作如下修订：-
4月9日
上午8时50分。海军上将将在外白渡桥附近的耶松码头登陆，并经百老汇路（Broadway）、百老汇路（Boone）、吴淞路、雷恩路（Range）和北四川路前往日本海军陆战队司令部。
上午9时15分。离开海军陆战队司令部，经江湾路从西门进入虹口公园。在此检阅陆战队官兵。
上午9时45分。离开公园，海军上将将经西门和江湾路返回海军陆战队司令部。
下午1时。离开达罗克路305号海军军官俱乐部，经江湾路前往视察前战区，并在虹口公园西门对面的铁路道口进入中国管辖区域。
（印：上海公共租界工部局 * 上海 * 19..年4月9日）
在同一点重新进入租界，并穿过以下道路前往北四川路635号海军陆战队分队驻地：-
江湾路、北四川路、斯科特路（Scott）、欧阳路（Uyang）（闸北）、四达路（Sutah）（闸北）、斯科特路、北四川路。

CONFIDENTIAL

S.l, Special Branch.
April 3, 1937.

Tour of Inspection to be made by Admiral Mineo Ohsumi
April 8 - 11, 1937

Admiral Mineo Ohsumi, Supreme War Councillor, and former
Naval Minister, who has been specially appointed inspector of
the Japanese Third Fleet in China waters by the Emperor of
Japan, will arrive here aboard the cruiser "Myoko" during the
morning of April 8. He will be accompanied by Rear-Admiral
Nobutake Hondo, Captains Masao Kanazawa and Kuninori Marumo
and Commander Ryusaku Yanagimoto. The vessel will tie up at
the Japanese naval buoy off Thorburn Road.

The Japanese Naval Authorities request the Municipal
Police to provide an escort for the admiral during his movements
in the Settlement and to adopt precautionary measures at the
places to be visited by him. They further request that strict
precautions be adopted at the Ewo Jetty, Wayside, from which
the admiral will land and leave for the vessel, and also on
the occasion of the parade to be held on Kiangwan Road and in
Hongkew Park on April 11.

The order of escort to the admiral will be as follows:-
Municipal Police (motorcar)
Officers of the Naval Landing Party (motorcar)
Admiral Ohsumi (motorcar)
9 motorcars occupied by the staff and senior officers
of the Third Fleet and the Naval Landing Party will
follow the above.
Military Police (motorcar)
Consular Police (motorcar).

The admiral's activities during his stay in Shanghai
include the following:-
pages.zh:
机密

S.l, 特别处。
1937年4月3日。

大角岑生海军上将拟于
1937年4月8日至11日进行的视察行程

日本最高军事参议官、前海军大臣大角岑生海军上将，由日本天皇特别任命为中国水域日本第三舰队视察官，将于4月8日上午乘巡洋舰“妙高”号抵达此处。随同前来的有本多信竹（Nobutake Hondo）海军少将、金泽正雄（Masao Kanazawa）大佐、丸毛国纪（Kuninori Marumo）大佐以及柳本龙作（Ryusaku Yanagimoto）中佐。该舰将停泊在索伯恩路（Thorburn Road）外的日本海军浮筒旁。

日本海军当局请求工部局警务处在海军上将于租界内行动期间提供护卫，并在其访问地点采取预防措施。他们进一步请求在外白渡桥附近的耶松码头（海军上将由此登陆及离境登船）以及4月11日在江湾路和虹口公园举行阅兵式时采取严格的预防措施。

海军上将的护卫序列如下：-
工部局警务处（汽车）
海军陆战队军官（汽车）
大角海军上将（汽车）
随后是9辆载有第三舰队及海军陆战队参谋和高级军官的汽车。
宪兵（汽车）
领事警察（汽车）。

海军上将在上海逗留期间的活动包括以下内容：-

Admiral Mineo Ohsumi, Supreme War Councillor, and former
Naval Minister, who has been specially appointed inspector of
the Japanese Third Fleet in China waters by the Emperor of
Japan, will arrive here aboard the cruiser "Myoko" during the
morning of April 8. He will be accompanied by Rear-Admiral
Nobutake Kondo, Captains Masso Kanazawa and Kuninori Marumo
and Commander Ryusaku Yanagimoto. The vessel will tie up at
the Japanese naval buoy off Thorburn Road.

Police to provide an escort for the admiral during his movements
in the Settlement and to adopt precautionary measures at the
places to be visited by him. They further request that strict
precautions be adopted at the Ewo Jetty, wayside, from which

the occasion of the parade to be held on Kiangwan Road and in
Hongkew Park on April 11.

9 motorcars occupied by the staff and senior officers

follow the above.

大角岑生海军上将拟于1937年4月8日至11日进行的巡视

大角岑生海军上将，最高战争顾问，前海军大臣，由日本天皇特别任命为日本第三舰队在中国水域的视察官，将于4月8日上午乘巡洋舰“妙高”号抵达此处。随同人员包括近藤信竹少将、金泽正雄大佐、丸目国纪大佐以及柳本龙作中佐。该舰将停泊在韬朋路外的日本海军浮筒处。

日本海军当局要求工部局警务处在海军上将于租界内行动期间提供护卫，并在其访问地点采取预防措施。他们进一步要求在耶松码头路边（海军上将由此登陆及离境登船处）采取严密预防措施，并在4月11日于江湾路及虹口公园举行的阅兵式期间采取同样措施。

海军上将的护卫顺序如下：
工部局警务处（汽车）
海军陆战队军官（汽车）
大角上将（汽车）
随后是9辆载有第三舰队及海军陆战队参谋和高级军官的汽车。
宪兵（汽车）
领事警察（汽车）。

THE SHANGHAI SUNDAY TIMES, APRIL 4, 1937

ADMIRAL OSUMI DUE
IN SHANGHAI
Former Navy Minister
To Inspect Naval
Units In China

Admiral Mineo Osumi, former
Navy Minister and special navy in-
spector for this year, will arrive
here next Thursday morning to in-
spect Japanese warships in port and
the local special naval landing
party.
The Admiral left Nagasaki yester-
day for Tsingtao, aboard the 10,000-
ton cruiser Myoko, to inspect the
units of the Third Fleet stationed in
the Shantung port.
After a three-day stay here, Ad-
miral Osumi will board the destroyer
Tsuga in the evening of April 11
for a trip to the up-river ports.
The Tsuga will be escorted by the
destroyer Kuri.
In the following six days, Ad-
miral Osumi will inspect warships
stationed in Nanking, Kiukiang and
Hankow.
Between April 23 and 25, the Ad-
miral himself, or members of his
suite will inspect warships in
Amoy, Canton and Ichang. He will
return to Nagasaki on April 26.
No formal functions honouring the
Admiral will be given at any of the
ports he will visit, and visits by
Japanese residents aboard warships
will not be permitted.
However, between April 12 and
15, while Admiral Osumi will be
away, local Japanese residents will
be allowed to visit the Myoko.—
Domei.

《上海星期泰晤士报》，1937 年 4 月 4 日

大角岑生海军上将即将抵沪
前海军大臣
将检阅在华海军部队

前海军大臣兼本年度海军特别视察官大角岑生（Mineo Osumi）海军上将，将于下周四上午抵达此地，检阅停泊在港口的日本军舰及当地特别海军陆战队。
大角海军上将昨日乘坐万吨级巡洋舰“妙高”号离开长崎前往青岛，以检阅驻扎在该山东港口的第三舰队部队。
在此停留三天后，大角海军上将将于 4 月 11 日晚登上驱逐舰“栎”号（Tsuga），前往长江上游港口。
“栎”号将由驱逐舰“栗”号（Kuri）护航。
在接下来的六天内，大角海军上将将检阅驻扎在南京、九江和汉口的军舰。
4 月 23 日至 25 日期间，大角海军上将本人或其随行人员将检阅厦门、广州和宜昌的军舰。他将于 4 月 26 日返回长崎。
在他访问的任何港口，都不会举行欢迎海军上将的正式活动，也不允许日本居民登舰访问。
然而，在 4 月 12 日至 15 日大角海军上将外出期间，将允许当地日本居民参观“妙高”号。——同盟社
